verdict.rationale: GitHub's mobile page says users can start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks through Agent Tasks on GitHub Mobile. It also says users can assign issues to Copilot, get a ready-to-review pull request, and refine, approve and merge it in the app, plus ask Copilot in natural language to open pull requests. Missing for 10: in-depth mobile-specific documentation (the claims come from a marketing page, while the detailed agent docs describe GitHub.com), and independent or hands-on confirmation of delegating to agents from the mobile app.
